content.short: TONAPI provides professional-grade infrastructure and APIs for developers building on the TON blockchain.
content.description: TONAPI is a robust and scalable API service that provides the essential infrastructure for developers to build and maintain applications on the TON blockchain. It offers a wide range of endpoints for accessing real-time network data, managing wallets, and interacting with smart contracts. By abstracting the complexities of running a full node, TONAPI enables developers to focus on building innovative products, from mobile wallets to sophisticated bots and DeFi protocols, ensuring high performance and reliability for their users.
content.meta: Build faster on TON with TONAPI's professional infrastructure. Access real-time data and tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
